description: Sign in with a wallet. Step 1: {address} → message to sign (EIP-191). Step 2: {message, signature} → token; pass it as Authorization: Bearer on the MCP connection (or as `token` on each tool call). This token is what every account change needs: a SIGN-IN-WITH-X header only re-opens paid links and reads (GET /api/v2/auth/siwx/challenge).
name: sign_in
title: Sign in with Ethereum
